title: Subash
desc: Subhash, an unemployed young man, joins the army to be able to marry his lover. However, when he returns from his deployment, he is shocked to see his brother leading a corrupt life.

title: Nizhal Nijamakirathu
desc: Venkatchalam lives with his sister Indumathi, who hates men and vows to never get married. When Sanjeevi, Venkatchalam's friend, meets Indumathi, he falls in love with her.

title: Thaali Kattiya Raasa
desc: Mythili falls in love with Pandian, the educated man of her village. However, they have to first deal with Mythili's cruel father who once ruined her sister's life.

title: Gandhi Pirantha Mann
desc: Balu, determined to honour his late parents' fight against caste discrimination, takes on the oppressive forces led by Rukmani's father, seeking justice and striving for social reform.
